_about: Fixes for directory/content/plugin-commands.json, which scripts/plugins-commands.mjs reads out of each released plugin. Key by plugin slug. false hides the plugin's commands. Otherwise: "hide" lists commands to leave out, and "help" replaces a command's help text (null removes it). "add" lists extra [command, help] pairs for commands the script can't find (help translated at run time, say), copied from the plugin's source. Only correct what the plugin actually says; don't invent help text.
